description: Undoes the whole of the last edit made through this server, however many Premiere steps it took (undo reverses one step; remove_silence or replace_clip take many). Undoes step by step until the sequence is exactly as it was before that call, and if it never gets there redoes everything, so a failed revert changes nothing. Refuses when the sequence changed after that call (those changes would be undone first) unless force is set. Calls made since this server started are tracked; call it again to go back one more. Markers added by script are not on Premiere's undo stack, so marker-only edits cannot be reverted this way.

force.description: Also undo changes made after that call

maxSteps.description: Most undo steps to try (default 40, max 200)

sequenceId.description: Revert the last edit on this sequence (default: the last edit anywhere)

name: revert_last_call
